purpose: Fail-closed benchmark for Semantic Director narrative decisions without changing Director IR v1.

cases.text: 我一直以为是市场不行，其实真正的问题是我们根本没有用户。
We thought growth was the problem. The truth is nobody retained.
前面所有数据都很好，但是用户第二天就不回来了。
Everything looked healthy, however retention collapsed the next day.
为什么一个看起来很好的产品，用户却不愿意回来？
Why would users leave after the first session?
我们在三月份上线了第一个版本。
